---
applyTo: "packages/genui/skill-lynx-openui/**,packages/genui/openui/**"
---

Keep the package-distributed Lynx OpenUI skill in the standalone `@lynx-js/skill-lynx-openui` workspace package at `packages/genui/skill-lynx-openui`. Put `SKILL.md` at the package root and keep optional agent metadata and reference material in `agents/` and `references/`. Do not re-export the skill from `@lynx-js/genui` or `@lynx-js/genui-openui`. Keep the skill's component signatures aligned with `createOpenUiPromptLibrary`, including parameter order, optionality, types, and enums, and keep examples parseable by the current OpenUI v0.5 parser. When the runtime supports reduced component libraries or a configurable root, make the skill follow the exact active Library vocabulary, use an explicit root override when supplied, and otherwise retain the Library's default `Stack` root. Keep Query assignment guidance aligned with host-side `initialQueryResults` keys without emitting host configuration in the DSL. Add an explicit changeset for SKILL or reference changes because the repository's automatic changed-file patterns only cover `src/**`.
